title: Master status and the Workers page show each session's CPU and memory beside its fair share, and alarm only on a session hogging a saturated machine
description: The loop reads four live session scopes on a 24-core host from their cgroup counters each cycle: one runs 14 cores, three run one each, a 6-core share apiece. Master status (sessionUsage) and the Workers page's Session usage table list each with its CPU and memory use and its share. While the machine is not saturated, or one session runs alone, no alarm is raised. Under CPU pressure 70, after five minutes over twice its share the greedy session raises the overload alarm naming it: one journal line, an attention line in master status and an alert on the Workers page; the others raise none, and the alarm clears when the pressure falls.

steps.name: each session's use and share are shown and only a session far over its share of a saturated machine raises the overload alarm
